taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

allometry.note: 32 cm at 4 years in the open, the middle of Flora of China's 15-50 cm. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

generator.params.note: Set by hand after Flora of China p. 136: one or several stems in a fascicle (3), each bare below but for scale leaves, with its leaves crowded at the top: two nodes of opposite leaves (four, the usual count of the genus's herbs, p. 133), on the upper share of the stem, nearly alike in size. Not fitted to measurements.

traits.life_span.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): perennial herbs.

traits.woodiness.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): perennial herbs.

traits.perennation.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): rhizomes procumbent, thick and short.

traits.leaf_habit.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as Flora of China does not say; its stems die back each year.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): 15-50 cm high.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): blades 7-15 by 3-6 cm.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): blades 7-15 by 3-6 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): petioles 0.8-2.5 cm.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): blades elliptic, obovate, ovate-lanceolate, suborbicular or broadly elliptic; elliptic the first named.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): spikes terminal, sometimes axillary, 1-3-branched, on a 1-3.5 cm peduncle.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as Flora of China gives the peduncle but not the spike's length.

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): flowers white (the three white stamen connectives are what shows); the RGB is the authors' rendering.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as Flora of China gives no fruit size.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): drupes green, globose or pear-shaped; the RGB is the authors' rendering of green.

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): flowers April-May, rarely to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Flora of China vol. 4 p. 136, Chloranthus serratus (read 2026-10-16): fruits June-August.
